name: headroom
note: CANDIDATE (Peti 2026-08-06, token/context-reduction research option A). Context-compression layer (MCP server / proxy / library) with reversible compression (CCR): compresses tool outputs, logs, files, RAG chunks BEFORE they reach the model, caches the original locally, model retrieves on demand via headroom_retrieve. Claimed 20% for coding agents, 60-95% for JSON/tool-output. This directly attacks the fleet's measured burn (450-480k ctx/call, cache-hit 98% so SIZE is the cost -- see fleet-cache-hit-is-98pct-size-is-the-cost). DUE DILIGENCE PENDING: license + maintenance NOT yet verified -- the egress-gate blocked both the direct WebFetch and the quarantine-reader (raw.githubusercontent.com not on quarantine allowlist). SECURITY GATE before any code-run pilot: (1) compression must be LOCAL-only, no external API (data-exfil); (2) the local original-cache must NOT persist secrets/tokens (our tool outputs carry the dashboard Bearer token); (3) no auto-run install hooks (graphify lesson). Lighter alternative to the HELD mcp-compressor entry. PLAN: /context measurement pass first (0-cost), then Headroom MCP pilot on ONE agent's tool-output path with Cybersec review, measure, then decide adopt/adapt.
description: Kontextus-tömörítő réteg (MCP/proxy) reversible compression-nel -- a tool-output/fájl méret vágására. DD függőben (egress-blokk), kód-pilot Cybersec-gate után.
